title: Scan-Parallel Variational Inference for event-driven Latent Jump Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous-time latent state-space models are widely used for irregularly observed time series, typically representing uncertainty through a random initial state followed by smooth ordinary differential equation (ODE) dynamics, or Brownian perturbations accumulated by a stochastic differential equation (SDE). While these constructions are natural for smooth or diffusive systems, they do not directly encode a finite set of unobserved shocks whose timing, magnitude, and effect on memory are themselves uncertain. We instead introduce latent jump models (LJMs): the latent state follows closed-form deterministic dynamics between Poisson-driven event times and undergoes a learned instantaneous jump at each event, with state-dependent intensity and mark distributions. This defines a time-homogeneous Markov process whose jumps are intrinsic state transitions rather than numerical integration steps. For training, we derive a tractable event-aug

translated_title: 面向事件驱动潜在跳跃模型的扫描并行变分推断
translated_abstract: 连续时间潜在状态空间模型被广泛应用于不规则观测的时间序列，通常通过一个随机初始状态加平滑的常微分方程（ODE）动力学，或通过随机微分方程（SDE）累积的布朗扰动来表示不确定性。虽然这些构造对于平滑或扩散系统而言是自然的，但它们并不能直接编码一组数量有限的未观测冲击，而这些冲击的发生时间、幅度及其对记忆的影响本身都是不确定的。我们转而提出潜在跳跃模型（LJMs）：潜在状态在泊松驱动的各事件时刻之间遵循闭式确定性动力学，并在每个事件时刻发生一次学习得到的瞬时跳跃，其强度和标记分布依赖于状态。这定义了一个时间齐次的马尔可夫过程，其跳跃是内在的状态转移，而非数值积分步长。在训练方面，我们推导了一种可处理的事件增广（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出潜在跳跃模型（LJMs），通过泊松事件驱动的可学习瞬时跳跃来显式建模不规则时间序列中未观测冲击的时间与幅度，并配套开发了扫描并行变分推断方法用于高效训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes latent jump models (LJMs) that explicitly model unobserved shocks in irregularly-sampled time series through Poisson-driven learnable instantaneous jumps, together with a scan-parallel variational inference algorithm for efficient training.
